svg.title: A Network .ant names, node release 0.3.0
svg.desc: Wallets sign .ant actions; the producer's rule engine seals AntDomain events and payments in a block; independent follower nodes replay every operation with the same rules; wallets resolve a name to an address and sign transfers to that address.
svg.text: WALLETS · KEYS NEVER LEAVE THE DEVICE
LAYER 1 PRODUCER (OPERATOR)
INDEPENDENT COMPUTERS
PAYING A NAME
ANET Wallet extension · mobile app · domains.html
Register, transfer, set resolver or primary name
List, buy, bid, settle (fixed / auction / domain-auction)
Each action signed: action-v1 · secp256k1 · per-action nonce
Not internet DNS
.ant is an A Network Layer 1 naming system
Browsers and ICANN resolvers do not resolve it
Only wallets, explorers and apps using the RPC
Producer node · rule engine (domain.rs)
Name rules, ownership, eligibility, listings, deadlines
Moves ANET buyer → seller, bidder → escrow → seller
Seals one AntDomain event per operation in the block
No fees · no admin override · permanent ownership
Follower nodes (anyone)
Replay every AntDomain event with the same rules
Check signature, nonce, eligibility, sealed attributes
Escrow balance = sum of open highest bids
Serve /domains/* from their own verified copy
Send to digitalgold.ant
GET /domains/name/digitalgold.ant → resolver address → show name, address, amount, fee, network → user confirms →
re-resolve (abort if changed) → sign a normal transfer to the address. A later resolver change cannot redirect it.
